work.description: The act settles doubts on the pontifical insignia of cardinals and bishops. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF23312-23314 reads: Datum Romae apud Sanctam Mariam Majorem sub Annulo Piscatoris die 1 Junii MDCCCXLVII. Pon- tificatus Nostri Anno Prirna.
